remarks: Would you like to enjoy Chautauqua every season during week 8? Consider this ONE-WEEK TIME SHARE for sale in condo #B4. Interval 8 corresponds every season to Chautauqua's week 8 and the usage dates for 2026 are 8/15/26-8/22/26. Usage dates for 2027 will be 8/14/27 - 8/21/27. No more looking for a one-week rental each season. There are two outdoor pools and a community grill. Enjoy the warm weather on either porch one is covered and one is an open deck. Split level layout with the main floor consisting of a living room, dining area, fully equipped kitchen and half bathroom. The lower level has two bedrooms and two bathrooms with tub/showers. The stairs up from the living room take you to a third loft bedroom. Linens, towels and cleaning after your stay are included. A Chautauqua gate pass is required during your stay. Parking on-site for one car in a reserved space for a fee. You may join RCI if you would like but it's not required.
